data.one_liner: A Column widget that automatically inserts separators between its children.
data.what_it_does: SeparatedColumn works like the standard Column but adds a separator widget between each child. It also supports optional outer separators before the first and after the last child.
use_when: You need a simple way to add dividers or other widgets between column items without manually inserting them.
You want configurable outer separators (before first or after last).
avoid_when: You require complex layout logic beyond simple separators.
Performance is critical for very large lists; consider using ListView with separators instead.
strengths: Supports outer separator mode for flexible UI designs.
weaknesses: Only works for Column layouts, not for scrollable lists.
Limited to static children; dynamic large data sets may need other solutions.
